name: DiscountFlow Studio for WooCommerce – Dynamic Pricing, Quantity Discounts & Promotional Banners
author: Prokash Sarker

sections.description:
DiscountFlow Studio for WooCommerce is the most flexible discount management plugin for WooCommerce store owners. Whether you want to run a sitewide sale, reward bulk buyers with quantity discounts, or display eye-catching promotional banners — DiscountFlow Studio handles it all from one clean settings panel.

Increase your average order value, reduce cart abandonment, and drive more conversions with powerful, rule-based discount strategies — no coding required.

🎯 Key Features

Global Discount Rules
Apply a percentage or fixed-amount discount across your entire WooCommerce product catalog in one click. Perfect for flash sales, seasonal promotions, and clearance events.

Product-Specific Discounts
Override global settings and set individual discount rules directly on each product — ideal for highlighting featured products or running targeted promotions.

Quantity-Based (Tiered) Discounts
Reward customers who buy more. Create unlimited tiered discount rules — for example, 10% off for 2–3 items, 15% off for 4 or more items. Rules are fully customizable or choose from built-in presets.

Promotional Banners
Automatically display attractive, attention-grabbing promo banners on single product pages and shop listing pages. Show discount percentages and coupon codes to encourage purchases.

Coupon Code Integration
Auto-generate WooCommerce-native coupon codes and display them in promotional banners. Customers see the promo code directly on the product page — reducing friction at checkout.

Discount Badges on Shop Page
Highlight discounted products with bold discount badges (e.g., -15% OFF) on WooCommerce shop loop pages to increase click-through rates.

Cart & Checkout Display
Show applied discounts and savings in the cart and checkout, giving customers full transparency and confidence in their purchase.

High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) Compatible
Fully compatible with WooCommerce’s modern HPOS (Custom Order Tables) for maximum performance and scalability.

💡 Who Is This For?

  • WooCommerce store owners running sales or promotions
  • Businesses offering bulk or wholesale pricing
  • Shop managers who want a no-code discount management solution
  • Developers building stores that need flexible, rule-based pricing

⚙️ How It Works

  1. Install & Activate — Install DiscountFlow Studio and activate it alongside WooCommerce.
  2. Configure Discounts — Go to WooCommerce → Discount Settings to set up your rules.
  3. Launch Promotions — Discounts, banners, and badges appear automatically on your storefront.

🔍 SEO & Performance

  • Lightweight — no bloat, no unnecessary scripts loaded on pages outside WooCommerce
  • All output properly escaped and sanitized following WordPress coding standards
  • Compatible with major caching plugins and page builders
sections.installation:
1. Upload the discountflow-studio-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install directly via the WordPress Plugins → Add New screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → Discount Settings to configure your discount rules.
  4. Save settings — discounts and banners will appear on your store immediately.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. DiscountFlow Studio for WooCommerce requires WooCommerce to be installed and active. If WooCommerce is not detected, the plugin will deactivate automatically and show an admin notice.

Can I use multiple discount types at the same time?

Yes. You can combine global discounts, product-specific discounts, and quantity-based (tiered) discounts simultaneously. The plugin automatically applies the best applicable discount for each product.

How does the quantity-based discount work?

You define rules based on the total number of items in the cart. For example: 10% off when 2–3 items are in the cart, 15% off when 4 or more items are added. You can use built-in preset rules or create fully custom rules.

Are discounts applied before or after taxes?

Discounts are applied to the product price before WooCommerce calculates taxes — following standard WooCommerce pricing behavior.

Can I display a coupon code to customers?

Yes. Enable the coupon code display in the settings and enter your promo code. DiscountFlow Studio will show it in a promotional banner on product pages (e.g., “Online exclusive. Use Code: SAVE20 in basket”). The coupon is also auto-created in WooCommerce.

Can I customize the promotional banner?

Yes. You can customize the prefix text (e.g., “Online exclusive. Use Code:”), the coupon code itself, and the suffix text (e.g., “in basket”) from the admin settings. For advanced styling, edit the frontend.css file in the plugin’s css/ directory.

Does this plugin work with variable products?

Yes. DiscountFlow Studio supports both simple and variable WooCommerce products.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. Full compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (Custom Order Tables) is declared.

Will this slow down my store?

No. The plugin only loads its scripts and styles on WooCommerce pages (shop, product, cart, checkout). Admin assets are only loaded on the Discount Settings page.
